source_summary: whitesiderouterbits.com product pages (specs, materials, RPM), 2027 full catalog (flute counts by section), Whiteside Vectric .tool / Fusion 360 tool files (starting feeds). Hercules HU/HD flute counts from Klingspor listings. Round 2 (2026-10-09): bearing-guided profile bits (roundover, cove, ogee, edge bevel, round nose, bowl & tray), RFT/RFTD/UDFT/Ultimate flush-trim spirals, panel and staggertooth bits, cabinet-door profile bits and the dowel-drill / hinge-boring line from the same product data; presets from the Vectric .tool files where Whiteside ships one.
